title: Fix stale password_hasher.dart path printed by tool/argon2id_benchmark.dart — file moved from features/auth to features/account
why: The benchmark tool prints instructions telling whoever runs it to 'Update Argon2idParams.production in lib/features/auth/domain/services/password_hasher.dart', but Argon2idParams and PasswordHasher actually live under lib/features/account/ — the feature was evidently renamed/relocated after this script was written and the printed path was never updated. Anyone following the tool's own output would open a path that doesn't exist.
recommendation: Update the stdout.writeln call to print lib/features/account/domain/services/password_hasher.dart.
acceptance_criteria: argon2id_benchmark.dart's printed path matches the real location of Argon2idParams.production
